title: Pretty and firm
text: Pretty and firm. Very nicely made except for the legs, they aren't real wood.  The futon is very firm.  The color is a bright white. I haven't slept on it but will give an update on it when I do.  It's ok for sitting.  A few pillows and lounging on it is fairly comfortable. I would recommend this as a short term sofa/bed.

features: Tufted, white faux leather upholstery with detail stitching
Sturdy wood frame that fits in tight spaces
Cleans easily with a damp cloth
description: Sturdy, durable and chic, DHP's Aria Futon Sofa bed is a perfect choice looking for a small futon to fit in tight spaces. The Aria futon has faux leather upholstery that is easy to clean with only a wipe down of a damp cloth. With its sleek, chic and modern appearance, the Aria Futon fits perfectly with most room decors.
